  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Planning
Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City at Planning@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0713
prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Alternate Ching Chiao, Alternate James Okazaki, Commissioner Howard Brody,
Commissioner John Dustin, Commissioner Jeri Wright, Vice Chair Shelley Boyle, and
Chair Kevin Cheng
POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Planning Commission
by submitting a public comment request and giving it to the Community Development Director
prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Planning Commission on items
that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Planning Commission may not discuss
or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3).
 The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to
follow up on such items.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

1.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  21­66 AT 1825 EL MOLINO AVENUE TO CONSTRUCT A NEW TWO­
  STORY HOME AND THE REMOVAL OF FIFTEEN TREES. (LCRA)
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission: 1. Determine that
  based on the whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 3 (New
  Construction or Conversion of Small Structures), and that there is no substantial
  evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2. Find that the proposed project meets the
  required findings; and 3. Approve the project.

2.  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  SAN MARINO, CALIFORNIA, RECOMMENDING THAT THE CITY
  COUNCIL ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. O­23­1406 ADDING MUNICIPAL
  CODE SECTION 23.06.16 TO IMPLEMENT STATE LAW REGARDING
  PARKING REQUIREMENTS WITHIN A HALF­MILE OF PUBLIC
  TRANSIT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission: 1. Review and
  recommend the City Council adopt the proposed draft Ordinances amending the
  Municipal Code by adding a new section adopting the Government Code by reference
  by adopting Resolution No. PCR­23­11 recommending the City Council adopt the draft
  Ordinance.

3.  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  SAN MARINO, CALIFORNIA, RECOMMENDING THAT THE CITY
  COUNCIL ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. O­23­1407 AMENDING
  MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 23.02.14 AND 23.15.03.1 TO ALLOW
  MINISTERIAL APPROVAL WHEN RECONFIGURING SPACE WITHIN
  AN EXISTING DWELLING UNIT IN THE SINGLE FAMILY (R­1) ZONE
  TO CREATE NO MORE THAN TWO ADDITIONAL BEDROOMS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Commission: 1. Review and recommend
  the City Council adopt the proposed draft Ordinances amending the Municipal Code
  to allow ministerial approval when reconfiguring space within an existing dwelling unit
  in the single­family (R­1) zone to create no more than two additional bedrooms by
  adopting Resolution No. PCR­23­10 recommending the City Council adopt the draft
  Ordinance.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

DIRECTOR'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the Community Development Director to inform the Planning
Commission and the public of any matters of interest.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
